behavior_rules: Focus on implementing and validating working runtime functionality.
Reports are limited to runtime debugging and validation evidence.
Do not pause implementation for governance work that is not required to run or secure the development runtime.
All code changes must remove a measured runtime failure, enable a required runtime feature, or make an exposed execution path safe enough to test.
Verify after each runtime change with the narrowest real execution probe.
verified_blockers_to_fix: Redis and PostgreSQL are absent from the running FinalAI environment.
No schema initialization creates the LakeData table.
Compose does not persist Redis or PostgreSQL data.
Telegram secrets are inherited by service containers that do not need them.
Telegram code execution/deploy commands are not restricted to an allowed chat.
Module deployment accepts an unsanitized path component.
torch 2.2.0 with numpy 2.0.2 has an ABI compatibility warning.
validation_after_changes: Parse/import Python modules with bytecode disabled.
Verify torch imports without the NumPy ABI warning.
Build and start the FinalAI compose stack.
Verify Redis, PostgreSQL schema, API gateway, LakeData query and Telegram API access.
Restart the stack and verify persisted data.
